_comment: The Ear's venue-logo registry. One entry per business we put on a page, so the same mark gets reused everywhere instead of being re-sourced each week. Every logo here came from the business's OWN site or official profile — never a stock/clip-art lookalike — and `source` records exactly where, so anyone can re-fetch or check it. `match` is how a nightlife.json `venue` string resolves to this entry: the venue field is compared case-insensitively against each string, and the LONGEST match wins (that's how 'Kern's Food Hall rooftop' still lands on kerns). Entries with no `logo` fall back to a typeset wordmark tile on the party page — the layout stays identical, so a missing file is never a hole.

_treatments.as-is: the venue's file, trimmed to its bounding box and scaled down; colors untouched
_treatments.ink-recolor: the mark was drawn light-on-dark (invisible on cream), so near-white strokes were repainted brand ink #171512 and the accent colors were left alone
_treatments.cropped: a sub-line irrelevant to us (another town, a tagline) was cropped off the bottom
